boundaries.name: gateLoweringOpaque
boundaries.obligation: No proof that plonky2's arithmetic/mul/add/select gates lower to the modelled integer arithmetic.

boundaries.name: boolTargetWellFormed
boundaries.obligation: BoolTarget arguments are assumed Boolean; the source never re-constrains them and conditional_and returns BoolTarget::new_unsafe.

boundaries.name: fieldRepresentativeAbstraction
boundaries.obligation: Field elements are modelled by integer representatives; no modular-reduction reasoning is performed.

boundaries.name: callerOneHotObligation
boundaries.obligation: select_vec adds no sum-to-one constraint; one-hotness of the indicator is discharged only by callers such as SwitchBoard.
